entities.summary: Seosan Song clan was one of the Korean clans. Their Bon-gwan was in Seosan, South Chungcheong Province. According to the research in 2000, the number of Seosan Song clan is 2713. Their founder was Song Mun ik who was a descendant of Song Ju eun. Song Ju eun was from Zingzhao country in Tang dynasty and served as a Ministry of Revenue. Song Mun ik was appointed as Prince of Seosan during Chungnyeol of Goryeo’s reign in Goryeo. Song Mun ik’s descendant began Seosan Song clan.
